allowed_changes.admission: one replacement batch may bypass the closed version gate after an enacted-OARS stale eviction without advancing ordinary dispatch cadence
allowed_changes.candidate_window: each decision exposes exactly the eight oldest ready in-window groups
allowed_changes.counterfactual_fifo: the enacted arm budgets against the oldest four groups in its fixed candidate window after OARS creates a partial weight cohort
allowed_changes.lifecycle: newest whole-batch surplus outside the fixed window is removed as oars_candidate_excess and is not labeled stale

prohibited_changes: training seed or controlled-release assignment changes
service budget or opportunity score changes
training-step, model, workload, or resource changes
candidate windows other than exactly eight
qualification outcome use in confirmatory estimates
